statement: At least one Russian missile or drone strike on Odesa city or oblast occurs between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-24.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC, Al Jazeera report, citing Ukrainian officials, a Russian strike on Odesa city or oblast occurring between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-24.
failure_condition: No Russian missile or drone strike on Odesa city or oblast occurs between 2026-08-10 and 2026-08-24.

statement: Saudi or Aramco officials acknowledge a new Houthi-claimed attack, or an intercepted attack, on Saudi territory occurring between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-20.
resolution: A Saudi government or Aramco statement acknowledges an attack or interception dated within the window, and at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC, Al Jazeera report that statement.
failure_condition: Saudi and Aramco officials acknowledge no new in-window attack or interception directed at Saudi territory.

statement: An attack on or seizure of a commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman, attributed to Iran or Iran-aligned forces, occurs between 2026-08-10 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, BBC report an in-window attack on or seizure of a commercial vessel in those waters, attributing it to Iran or Iran-aligned forces.
failure_condition: No commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman is attacked or seized by Iran or Iran-aligned forces within the window.

statement: The Israeli government publicly accepts a Gaza agreement based on the Trump 15-point framework, in original or amended form, between 2026-08-10 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: An Israeli Prime Minister office or cabinet statement of acceptance is issued within the window and reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, BBC, Al Jazeera.
failure_condition: Israel issues no official acceptance of the framework in any form within the window.

statement: The UN General Assembly adopts a resolution appointing a woman as the next Secretary-General for the term beginning 2027-01-01, between 2026-08-10 and 2027-01-31.
resolution: UN official records at un.org show a General Assembly appointment resolution adopted within the window naming a woman as Secretary-General for the term starting 2027-01-01.
failure_condition: No in-window appointment resolution is adopted, or the person appointed is a man.

statement: The company Irregular or its officers are named on the OFAC SDN list, or in an unsealed US federal indictment concerning AI-system intrusions, between 2026-08-10 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: The OFAC SDN list carries an in-window entry, or a public US federal court docket shows an in-window unsealed indictment, naming Irregular or its officers.
failure_condition: Neither an SDN listing nor an unsealed federal indictment naming Irregular or its officers appears within the window.

statement: The USGS earthquake catalog lists at least one magnitude 7.0 or greater earthquake worldwide with origin time between 2026-08-10 and 2026-10-08.
resolution: The USGS catalog at earthquake.usgs.gov, queried on the deadline, lists at least one event of magnitude 7.0 or greater with origin time inside the window.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 7.0 or greater with origin time in the window enters the USGS catalog.

statement: Typhoon Dolphin makes landfall on the coast of mainland China or Hainan, excluding Taiwan, between 2026-08-09 and 2026-08-16.
resolution: CMA or JMA bulletins, or at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP, report the storm center making landfall on mainland China or Hainan, excluding Taiwan, within the window.
failure_condition: The storm center makes no in-window landfall on mainland China or Hainan.

statement: The FRED series DCOILBRENTEU records a Brent spot price at or above 90.00 US dollars for at least one date between 2026-08-10 and 2026-11-27.
resolution: FRED series DCOILBRENTEU, queried on the deadline, shows at least one daily value at or above 90.00 for a date within the window.
failure_condition: Brent spot per DCOILBRENTEU stays below 90.00 on every date in the window.

statement: Daniel Kinahan makes a first appearance before a court in Ireland between 2026-08-10 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: Courts Service of Ireland listings, or at least two of RTE, BBC, Irish Times, Reuters, report an in-window Irish court appearance by Daniel Kinahan.
failure_condition: Kinahan makes no appearance before an Irish court within the window.
